title: Anne Hathaway ‘Spent a Week’ Prepping for Harley Quinn Before ‘Dark Knight Rises’ Meeting; Nolan Didn’t Reveal Catwoman Until Two Hours Into Their Chat
content:
ByZack Sharf

Digital News Director

Anna Hathaway said on the “Happy Sad Confused” podcast that she spent a full week channeling Harley Quinn before meetingChristopher Nolanfor “The Dark Knight Rises” because she was convinced he was courting her to play the Batman villain. It wasn’t until two hours into their meeting that Hathaway discovered it was a meeting for Catwoman.

“Here’s the thing that worked in my favor: she’s a chameleon,” Hathaway said. “So, I knew I was auditioning for… I was meeting with Chris [Nolan] for the female role in the Batman trilogy, the next installment. I thought that I’d gamed it out, because I was just like, ‘It can’t be Catwoman because Michelle Pfeiffer was so iconic… [gasp] It’s going to be Harley Quinn!'”

“So, I spent a week developing demonic Harley Quinn energy. I was wearing weird jester flats and a striped top,” she continued. “And then, about two hours into our conversation, Chris is like, ‘So, the part’s Catwoman,’ and I was like, ‘Transform!’ So, I just then decided that I was like, ‘Well, this top is very sensual.’ And I was going to be very… like a psychopath. I changed personalities like a psychopath.”

Hathaway won the part and went on to earn acclaim for playing Selina Kyle/Catwoman in “The Dark Knight Rises,” which marked her first collaboration with Nolan. The duo has since worked together on “Interstellar” and the upcoming “The Odyssey.” Hathawayhas long credited Nolanwith saving her career amid backlash around her Oscar win for “Les Misérables.” Public opinion soured on Hathaway at the time, and she infamously googled herself and discovered the top search question was: “Why does everyone hateAnne Hathaway?”

“A lot of people wouldn’t give me roles because they were so concerned about how toxic my identity had become online,” Hathaway now told Vanity Fair in 2024. “I had an angel in Christopher Nolan, who did not care about that and gave me one of the most beautiful roles I’ve had in one of the best films that I’ve been a part of.”

Hathaway was referring to the role of NASA scientist Dr. Amelia Brand in Nolan’s 2014 space epic “Interstellar.” Now they are back together for “The Odyssey,” in theaters July 17 from Universal Pictures.
title_zh: 安·海瑟薇(Anne Hathaway)在與克里斯多福·諾蘭(Christopher Nolan)會面之前，為哈莉·奎茵(Harley Quinn)的角色準備了整整一週；而諾蘭直到他們交談兩小時後才透露貓女(Catwoman)的角色。
content_zh:
扎克·沙夫(Zack Sharf)

數位新聞總監

安娜·海瑟薇(Anne Hathaway)在《快樂悲傷困惑(Happy Sad Confused)》播客上表示，她在與克里斯多福·諾蘭(Christopher Nolan)會面之前，花了一整週的時間來塑造哈莉·奎茵(Harley Quinn)的角色，因為她相信他是在邀請她飾演這位蝙蝠俠的反派。直到會議進行了兩個小時，海瑟薇才發現這是一次關於貓女(Catwoman)的會議。

“這裡有一點對我有利：她是一個變色龍，”海瑟薇說。“所以，我知道我是在試鏡…我是在和克里斯[諾蘭]會面，為蝙蝠俠三部曲的女性角色，下一部作品。我以為我已經想通了，因為我想，‘不可能是貓女，因為米歇爾·菲佛(Michelle Pfeiffer)實在是太具代表性了… [驚訝] 那一定是哈莉·奎茵！’”

“所以，我花了一週的時間來發展惡魔般的哈莉·奎茵能量。我穿著奇怪的小丑平底鞋和條紋上衣，”她接著說。“然後，在我們對話進行了大約兩個小時後，克里斯就說，‘所以，這個角色是貓女，’我當時就想，‘變身！’所以，我就決定，‘好吧，這件上衣非常性感。’我會非常…像個精神病患者。我像精神病患者一樣改變了個性。”

海瑟薇最終贏得了這個角色，並因在《黑暗騎士崛起(The Dark Knight Rises)》中飾演塞琳娜·凱爾(Selina Kyle)/貓女而獲得讚譽，這也是她與諾蘭的首次合作。這對搭檔之後還在《星際穿越(Interstellar)》和即將上映的《奧德賽(The Odyssey)》中合作。海瑟薇長期以來一直感謝諾蘭在她因《悲慘世界(Les Misérables)》奪得奧斯卡獎而受到的反彈中拯救了她的職業生涯。當時公眾對海瑟薇的看法變得不佳，她甚至上網搜尋自己，發現最熱門的問題是：“為什麼大家都討厭安娜·海瑟薇？”

“很多人不願意給我角色，因為他們非常擔心我在網上的形象變得多麼有毒，”海瑟薇在2024年告訴《名利場(Vanity Fair)》。 “我有一位天使，克里斯多福·諾蘭，他不在乎這些，並給了我在我參與過的最佳電影之一中最美麗的角色。”

海瑟薇指的是在諾蘭2014年太空史詩《星際穿越(Interstellar)》中飾演的NASA科學家阿米莉亞·布蘭德(Dr. Amelia Brand)。現在他們再次合作，這部電影《奧德賽(The Odyssey)》將於7月17日由環球影業(Universal Pictures)上映。
